newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks down in sparse London trading.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks down in sparse London trading.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks were slightly lower in London on Monday with only minimal movement in stocks, traders said.

The Hang Seng London Reference Index was down 36.70 points at 12,735.16 by 1540 GMT, after speculative interest in Hong Kong Telecom shares helped push the Hang Seng up 20.70 points to close at 12,771.86 in Hong Kong earlier today. Trading levels were thin and the market drifted down for most of the day, in spite of a slight increase in activity when Wall Street opened.

The market is expected to continue downwards this week, with investors' attention fixed on U.S. economic data. "You've got a lot of figures coming out of New York and people will have their eyes on these for the rest of the week," one trader said. "The market is a bit toppy at these levels." HSBC Holdings shares eased slightly to trade at HK$ 160.70, down from their close of HK$161.0 in Hong Kong.
-- John Sutherland, London Newsroom +44 1717 542 7945 (c) Reuters Limited 1996
